messages:
sam_cs: quick capture from three onboarding calls this morning - grouping asks about evals, regression alerts, and onboarding playbooks. dropping raw quotes + suggested split so product/research/enablement can triage.

- Adoptly (Scale SaaS): wants baseline eval set they can upload and have run automatically on every model deploy. quote: "we need a reproducible eval run so we can detect regressions before customers see them."
- FinAlpha (FinServ pilot): reported a hallucination spike after a nightly model refresh; they want configurable alerting + SLA for regressions during pilot. quote: "If hallucinations jump we lose trust with traders - we need alerts and a canary."
- Shoplify (PLG): asks for a shared prompt library + example eval prompts in onboarding so their PMs can get started quickly.

link to notes: drive/onboard/evals-capture-2025.csv (shared). can we split into quick-win vs investigate vs roadmap? :eyes:

jordan_pm: great summary. quick q: how urgent are these from a renewal perspective? any quotes that sound like renewal blockers? also any sample eval files attached?

sam_cs: FinAlpha explicitly said renewal-risk if we can’t provide canary/alerting during their pilot - marked renewal-watch/high. Adoptly is more ops-maturity ask (medium). Shoplify is enablement friction (low). i attached a sample eval csv from Adoptly in the drive.

lia_research: from research side: we have a reference eval runner but customers want two things: 1) a simple upload + run-on-demand UX, 2) a lightweight alerting hook with thresholds (e.g., F1 drop > 5% or hallucination-rate > 0.5%). sample eval config below: 

```
# sample eval config (yaml)
name: adoptly-baseline
metrics:
  - name: exact_match
  - name: rouge_l
  - name: hallucination_rate
triggers:
  - metric: hallucination_rate
    threshold: 0.005
    severity: critical
  - metric: exact_match
    threshold_drop: 0.05
    severity: warning
run_on: [deploy, manual]
notification: { type: webhook, url: https://hooks.customer.example.com/eval-alerts }
```

lia_research: note: the hallucination metric needs ground-truth which some customers supply via small seed sets; others prefer human-in-the-loop sampling.

mike_eng: implementation notes: 1) run-on-deploy hooks are doable by wiring the eval runner into our deploy pipeline. compute costs depend on eval size. 2) alerting: implement webhook + email + slack channels, with throttling and dedupe. 3) for canary rollouts + auto-rollback we need a small control plane change - roadmap-level but high value for FinAlpha.

mike_eng: propose triage lanes:
- Quick wins (1 sprint): enable customers to upload evals & run manually; provide enablement template for basic prompts + sample config; simple webhook alert delivery.
- Investigate (sprint): auto-run on model deploy + add metrics pipeline (eval runner -> metrics store -> alert rules); cost estimate and throttling policy.
- Roadmap (Q2): integrated canary rollouts with automated scoring + rollback and per-customer alert dashboards.

becca_enablement: i'll draft a one-pager onboarding playbook for evals (2 pages): 1) what to provide (seed prompts/ground-truth), 2) recommended thresholds for common metrics, 3) sample webhook receiver. will include copy snippets CSMs can paste. can share first draft by EOD tomorrow.

workbot: tip: use `/create_issue quick "evals-upload-enablement"` to create a starter ticket. use `/create_issue investigate "evals-autodeploy"` for infra.

sam_cs: i'll create GH issues and attach customer quotes + Adoptly sample eval. tagging FinAlpha as renewal-watch/high on the investigate ticket.

jordan_pm: prioritise FinAlpha as P0 for investigate lane given renewal risk. if auto-canary proves costly we can fallback to managed canary for pilots (CS-run).

mike_eng: i'll draft estimates for quick-win (upload + webhook) today and post numbers here. if approved i'll slot into next sprint.

sam_cs: thanks everyone. becca will produce the playbook, lia will help with metric definitions, mike will post estimates, and i'll follow up with FinAlpha to schedule a canary run for the pilot. closing loop for now, will link GH issues when created. :white_check_mark:
